intro.text: One last parcel. The rain has blurred the address, and whoever sent it wrote: before the lights go out.
intro.speaker: harpreet

note.text: A handwritten note: keep this dry. Tonight, a whole neighbourhood is counting on one little light.
note.speaker: harpreet

parcelTaken.text: Still warm inside. But the label is soaked. Better dry it gently, without opening the parcel.
parcelTaken.speaker: harpreet

lamp.text: A warm desk lamp. Good for drying something delicate.
lamp.speaker: harpreet

labelDry.text: There it is. The Old Picture House, Clocktower Hill. A replacement projector bulb. Tonight is their first show in years.
labelDry.speaker: harpreet

paperTaken.text: A square of coloured paper. Too cheerful to leave behind.
paperTaken.speaker: harpreet

pencilTaken.text: A pencil. Every delivery needs a little paperwork.
pencilTaken.speaker: harpreet

pinwheelMade.text: A fold, a twist, and a pencil for a handle. One extremely advanced wind-powered spaceship.
pinwheelMade.speaker: harpreet

courtyardFirst.text: The rain has stopped. Unfortunately, my scooter seems to have taken the evening off.
courtyardFirst.speaker: harpreet

scooterBroken.text: A loose battery terminal, and an empty headlight fuse holder. Meena will know where to find a spanner.
scooterBroken.speaker: harpreet

needParcel.text: I should collect the parcel upstairs before heading out.
needParcel.speaker: harpreet

needLabel.text: I need a readable address before choosing a road.
needLabel.speaker: harpreet

needCable.text: That loose terminal is still stopping the engine.
needCable.speaker: harpreet

needFuse.text: The engine is ready, but the hill road will be dark. I still need the headlight fuse.
needFuse.speaker: harpreet

flood.text: The underpass is flooded. The high road past the clocktower should still be open.
flood.speaker: harpreet

kabirHello.text: Captain Kabir reporting! I found a tiny space crystal beside your scooter. It fits perfectly in my spaceship.
kabirHello.speaker: kabir

crystal.text: It is your fuse? Oh. Can we trade? Something that spins, or something warm. Space is surprisingly cold.
crystal.speaker: kabir

picture.text: The blue lantern on the hill! Mum says the cinema opens tonight, if the projector works. Are you taking its missing bit?
picture.speaker: kabir

kabirAfter.text: A real film on a giant screen! Save me a seat near the front.
kabirAfter.speaker: kabir

pinwheelTrade.text: Whoa! A wind engine! Definitely an upgrade. Here is your little glass fuse, captain.
pinwheelTrade.speaker: kabir

chaiTrade.text: Warm chai! That is much better than a cold space crystal. Here, your fuse.
chaiTrade.speaker: kabir

fuseFit.text: A perfect fit. And there is the headlight. We are back in business.
fuseFit.speaker: harpreet

meenaHello.text: Last delivery, Harpreet? You have that one-more-problem face. What has the scooter done now?
meenaHello.speaker: meena

tools.text: Take the spanner from my tool roll. Tighten the terminal, gently. And have a chai if you need one.
tools.speaker: meena

cinema.text: The Picture House has been dark for years. Tonight, the owner promised a free show. Without that bulb, it stays a promise.
cinema.speaker: meena

wrenchTaken.text: Just the size I need. I will bring it back tomorrow.
wrenchTaken.speaker: harpreet

chaiTaken.text: One warm chai. Meena always makes an extra.
chaiTaken.speaker: harpreet

repair.text: A quarter turn. A snug connection. Let us hear that engine again.
repair.speaker: harpreet

radio.text: The radio says more rain is coming. We have a little time, but not the whole evening.
radio.speaker: harpreet

poster.text: Tonight: the return of the Old Picture House. Doors open at dusk. Someone has drawn a little blue lantern beside the address.
poster.speaker: harpreet

ready.text: Parcel safe. Engine running. Headlight on. Now, which way to the Picture House?
ready.speaker: harpreet

wrongRoad.text: Water right across the underpass. No delivery is worth losing the scooter. We will take the hill.
wrongRoad.speaker: harpreet

road.text: Come on, old friend. One more climb. There is a whole audience waiting for us.
road.speaker: harpreet

arrival.text: A blue lantern. A locked door. Then footsteps from inside. I think we made it.
arrival.speaker: harpreet

delivered.text: The bulb is in. The projector is turning. Sometimes a small parcel carries a whole evening.
delivered.speaker: harpreet

finalKid.text: You did it! Look, the screen is lighting up!
finalKid.speaker: kabir

cantCombine.text: That does not help here. Let me look at what this actually needs.
cantCombine.speaker: harpreet

alreadyDry.text: The address is clear now: Old Picture House, Clocktower Hill.
alreadyDry.speaker: harpreet

alreadyFixed.text: The cable is secure. No need to keep tightening it.
alreadyFixed.speaker: harpreet

saveResume.text: Back to the last delivery. The neighbourhood is still waiting.
saveResume.speaker: harpreet
